training: None. Sampling uses compatible random cross-attention; depth uses unchanged trained checkpoints.
sampling_export_failure: The first full attempt wrapped an eval network in a newly constructed training=True wrapper. Legacy ONNX export recursively restored training mode and output validation failed. That process was stopped; directory and logs remain. Fix: module.eval() before export; separate TRT gate passed. Only sampling C2 r3 and C0 final enter the report.
random_projection_control: Native MSDeformAttn initializes offset/attention matrices to zero. Formal point screening uses nonzero N(0,.01) matrices and common point prefixes to keep projections input-dependent under optimization. Early zero-initialized smoke/gate results are excluded.
coco_json_failure: First 8-image depth gate passed all observed/early-exit equivalence checks, then JSON serialization rejected a NumPy int64 from COCOeval. Fixed by using project JSON writer with NumPy scalar support; reran gate in a new directory before full evaluation.
precision_warning: TensorRT FP16 builds clipped out-of-range Constant nodes to +/-65504. Output shape/finite checks passed, but no FP16 AP acceptance is claimed.
measurement_limits: 500 samples/condition in 10 randomized paired rounds. Microsecond-scale independent Attention means can have wide bootstrap intervals; a positive mean alone does not prove stable acceleration. One TensorRT build per case; tactic/build variability is not inside CI.
archive_policy: Raw CUDA series retained; full wall series stay in server assessments with SHA/size; block and pooled wall stats retained. Predictions, raw stage tensors, official GT ID lists, ONNX/engine and full logs are server-only. No originals were deleted.

archival_host_audit.scope: CPU/system details checked at archival; configured threads follow measured source configure()
